description: Projektionszoner Sweref 99 för järnvägsanläggning is a dataset listed in Geodata Portal Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Lantmäteriet. The data product consists of two object types: projection zone which contains surfaces representing the current Sweref 99 projection zone for road and railway installations managed by the Swedish Transport Administration, and intersection point which represents the point in the railway installation at which the projection zone is changed. Coverage: SE. The portal shows the English title as "Projection zones Sweref 99 for railway plant" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Datapaket och specialprodukter, Data packages and special products. The listing shows 2019-08-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
